requirements: R1: The backend application must start successfully without Flyway validation errors and report healthy on its correct actuator endpoint.
R2: The backup service must successfully execute its initialization script without volume mapping directory errors.

slices.title: Resolve Runtime Environment Initialization Issues
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime environment fixes for this epic, I want to repair container volume mappings, entrypoints, and configuration, so that the system starts successfully and passes health checks.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the backend application starts, When Flyway validates migrations, Then it must ignore missing migrations to avoid startup failure.
Given the backend container health check, When Docker polls the service, Then it must query the /actuator/health endpoint and succeed.
Given the backup container configuration, When it starts, Then it must mount the scripts directory and execute the backup script correctly without directory errors.
